tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Free: agent status, trading mode and kill-switch state. No account data.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Free: search open prediction markets by text. Returns market ids, outcomes and token ids.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Order-book quote for one outcome: best bid and ask, mid, spread and top five levels of depth. $0.005 USDC per call on Base. Live data, not advice.

tools.name: estimate_fill
tools.description: Fill estimate for buying a number of shares of one outcome: VWAP, total cost and partial-fill status within a slippage cap. $0.01 USDC per call on Base. Not advice.

tools.name: get_odds_trends
tools.description: Stored odds-comparison snapshots from the arbitrage worker for trend analysis. $0.01 USDC per call on Base.

tools.name: get_odds_trends_summary
tools.description: Aggregated edge trends per event from stored snapshots: min/max/avg taker edge and best expected maker edge. $0.01 USDC per call on Base.
